title: WebToApp Configuration
description: Configuration file for the webtoapp conversion pipeline

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for VS Code autocomplete

name.description: Human-readable app name used in installer UI and window title

source.description: Absolute or relative path to the source project root

output.description: Absolute or relative path for the converted output project. Defaults to <source>-desktop

targets.description: One or more target platforms to build installers for

mode.description: online: original cloud backend kept as-is (Supabase/Firebase untouched).

icon.description: Path to a 512x512 PNG icon, relative to source root. Auto-detected if omitted.

author.description: Author name written into package.json (required by electron-builder)

type.description: auto: detect and replace. express: always generate local server. none: static only.

port.description: Port for the local Express server

type.description: local: generate JWT auth backed by SQLite users table. none: strip auth (single-user).

defaultAdmin.description: Default admin email for the seeded account

type.description: sqlite: use better-sqlite3. none: no database generation.

migrations.description: Path to Supabase SQL migrations folder, relative to source root

devTools.description: Open Electron DevTools in the output app

dryRun.description: Log every planned action but skip all file writes and npm installs

resumeFromStage.description: Resume the pipeline from this stage, skipping earlier completed stages

cleanLogs.description: Delete the conversion log file after a successful pipeline run

behaviorParity.description: Controls the post-build behavior parity gate. strict blocks packaging when selected-mode behavior cannot be preserved; warn logs findings; off disables the gate.

mobile.description: Mobile-specific build settings. Only used when 'android' or 'ios' appears in targets.

webDir.description: Directory containing built web assets, relative to the converted project

targetSdkVersion.description: Target Android SDK version. Google Play requires API 35+ for new apps and updates.

buildVariant.description: debug: unsigned APK for testing. release: signed release artifact.

artifactType.description: Release artifact type. Use aab for Google Play.

keystorePath.description: Path to the release keystore file, relative to source root

keystoreAliasPassword.description: Key password for release signing. Defaults to keystorePassword if omitted.

developmentTeam.description: Apple developer team ID for Xcode signing. Found in Xcode → Signing & Capabilities.
